svg.title: Streaming-WAM streaming overview, temporal overlap, and action-conditioned attention
svg.desc: The global spacetime overview shows consecutive Stream updates overlapping continuous robot execution. The lower temporal view marks O1 at the overlap boundary and aligns shared actions across A0 and A1. A1 shared actions directly feed both the shared-action slots and Stream Update, while the shared-action slots and unknown-action slots form a separate condition input. A ten-by-ten attention mask highlights the two shared-action links into the next visual-future query.
